description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Base Attack Bonus +5, Sneak Attack (4d6+), Sleight of Hand 5 ranks, Quick Draw

Benefit: As a full-round action, make a special Sneak Attack roll, substituting a Sleight of Hand check for Bluff to feint as a free action; success leaves the target flat-footed until its next turn, but you take a -4 AC penalty for 1 round. Usable once per day, plus once per 6 character levels.

system.requirements: Base Attack Bonus +5, Sneak Attack (4d6+), Sleight of Hand 5 ranks, Quick Draw
